service.en: Abu Dhabi Golden Visa for non-real-estate investors
service.ur: ابوظہبی گولڈن ویزا غیر رئیل اسٹیٹ سرمایہ کار
service.ml: അബുദാബി ഗോൾഡൻ വിസ (റിയൽ എസ്റ്റേറ്റ് ഇതര നിക്ഷേപകർ)

about: Ten-year residence for investors who put money into a company or deposit.
note: Requirements read from the official ADDED long-term residency page on the checked date. The visa itself is applied for through ICP, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Invest at least AED 2 million as a bank deposit or company ownership, or show at least AED 250,000 in tax paid in each of the last two years
Covers spouse, children, one advisor and one executive director
documents: Commercial registration certificate showing paid-in capital and ownership share
Bank or fund letter confirming the AED 2 million (investment route)
Commercial register copy showing no attachments
Tax returns and receipts for both years (tax route)
channels: UAE residents apply for nomination through TAMM (Abu Dhabi Residents Office)
